s: tri, (dA + “aco yat .” 3 । 1 । 97 । iti yat । “Idyati .” 6 । 4 । 65 । iti It .) dAtavyam । dAnIyam । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ yaTA, hitopadeSe । 1 । 36 । “udyoginaM puruzasiMhamupEti lakzmIrdEvena deyamiti kApuruzA vadanti ॥”)
v: tri॰ dA--karmaRi yat । 1 dAtavye “svaMkawumbAviroDena deyaM dArasutAdfte । nAnvaye sati sarvasvaM yaccAnyasmE prAtaSrutam yAjYa॰ vacanoktanizidDaBinne 2 dAnArhe dattApradAnikaSabde 3455 । 56 pf॰ dfSyam ।
m: देय mfn. (√ 1. दा) to be given or presented or granted or shown
fit or proper for a gift, AV.; TS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
to be or being given in matrimony (cf. ब्रह्म-)
to be delivered or handed over, Mn. viii, 185
to be paid (as a debt, wages, taxes &c.), Mn.; Yājñ.
to be laid or set to (as fire), MBh.; Bhpr.
देय n. giving, gift (cf. अ-, बल-, मघ-, राधो-, वसु-, वैर-)
a: देय — a. [दा कर्मणि यत्] 1 To be given, offered or presented; R. 3. 16. --2 Fit to be given, proper for a gift. --3 To be returned or restored; विभावितैकदेशेन देयं यदभियुज्यते V. 4. 17; Ms. 8. 139, 185. --4 To be shown. --5 To be given in marriage. --6 To be paid (as a debt &c.). --7 To be placed, put, applied, laid, &c.; see दा above. --यं A gift, donation.

m: देय—धर्म m. ‘the duty of giving’, charity, Buddh.
